q = int(input().strip())
for _ in range(q):
    s = input().strip()
    t = input().strip()
    possible = False
    for i in range(len(s)):
        for j in range(i, len(s)):
            # Build the string that could be generated by starting at i, moving right to j, then moving back left.
            candidate = s[i:j+1] + s[j-1:i:-1] if i != j else s[i:j+1]
            if candidate == t:
                possible = True
                break
        if possible:
            break
    print("YES" if possible else "NO")
